failure_summary.description: Returned a related institution or organization instead of the entity explicitly requested by the clue.
Anchored on a matching title or phrase while overlooking the full clue and its requested answer slot.
Returned text associated with a trivia entry rather than solving the clue that followed it.
Omitted a conventional honorific that was part of the supported name form.

patch.reasoning: The failures involving target selection, clue interpretation, and trivia-entry parsing are already addressed by the skill, so adding more rules for them would duplicate existing guidance. The name-form guidance can be clarified to prefer a supported canonical form over the shortest unambiguous one.

edits.target: Use a name form that uniquely identifies the entity: give the complete identifying name when needed, but a surname or shorter form is appropriate when it is unambiguous.
edits.content: Use the canonical name form supported by the clue and context, not merely the shortest uniquely identifying string. Give the complete identifying name when needed, and retain conventional name components or honorifics when sources present them as part of the expected form; use a shorter form when it is itself the conventional answer form and remains unambiguous.
